summary: StudentPreInfControl is a web user control in the HSPnet application, designed to manage and display student infection control prerequisites, including various mask-related fields and infection control solutions. The control consists of FormViews for displaying and editing student prerequisite data, integrates DropDownLists for mask sizes and solutions, uses AJAX for calendar selection, and ensures fields are properly translated and populated for both English and French language users.
purpose: To facilitate tracking, viewing, and editing the infection control prerequisites for students, including mask fit test dates, mask sizes, alternative mask sizes, mask expiry checks, and infection control solutions. The control ensures correct data entry, localization, workflow handling, and proper UI behavior for authorized users.

workflows.name: Student Infection Control Prerequisite Management
steps: ObjectDataSource selects student prerequisite details based on StudentID and UserSession.
FormView fvmStdPrerequisite displays and translates fields.
User initiates edit (cmdEdit), switches FormView to edit mode, shows modal popup.
User enters/edit mask size, alt mask size, mask fit test date, expiry check, infection control solution.
Dropdown values are selected and populated correctly, with localization applied.
JavaScript variables initialized and registered for client validation and async postbacks.
User saves changes (cmdSave), triggering ItemUpdating event.
Validation executed; if invalid, update is canceled.
If valid, new values updated and redirected.
Session updated and user redirected to InfectionControl page.

business_rules: Mask size values must be properly localized and selected in English regardless of UI language.
Update is canceled if Page.IsValid returns false during ItemUpdating.
Grid disables edit fields if ScreenIsEditable is false.
Dropdown for N95MaskSizeCode uses English 'Unknown' value if not set from localization.
Add blank entry to dropdowns as needed for selection.
validations: DropDownLists and input values must correspond to valid mask sizes, fit test dates, expiry checks, and infection control solutions.
ValidationSummary control used to summarize validation errors.
calculations: MaxDate calculated as current date plus maximum allowed future years for mask expiry.
N95MaskSizeUnknownCodeID determined dynamically based on localization and dropdown contents.
conditions: ScreenIsEditable determines if fields can be edited.
ReadOnly flag disables edit controls and calendars.
UserSession presence required for ObjectDataSource selection; if absent, selection is canceled.
system_behavior: FormView switches between display, edit, and insert modes.
Edit fields disabled if ScreenIsEditable is false.
JavaScript variables injected for client-side behavior.
On update, session is cached and user redirected.
dependencies: Grid utility for handling edit/view mode transitions.
Dropdown utility for selection and localization.
exceptions: If UserSession is missing, data source selection is canceled.
If update fails validation, changes are not applied.
Dropdown localization may fail if French resources are used but English values required.
